title: Any good in your mind?
html_source: Birdie Kelly is the girl with whom he first had a sexual experience. Bloom is in nighttown, having followed Stephen, out of concern for him. With her bat-like appearance, she asks him, “Any good in your mind?” likely inferring “Are you having a “nice” time? while, since this is Bloom’s imagining, he may have her asking him “Is there any good in your mind?” an answer to which there may not be a readily available for him, despite his charitable sense of concern for Stephen.
